chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) through a chain-of-retrieval approach, which is a core application of efficient reasoning.
The paper proposes decoding strategies to scale test-time compute by controlling the length and number of sampled retrieval chains, aligning with test-time scaling.
The methodology involves sampling multiple retrieval chains and using decoding strategies to select or aggregate them, which relates to parallel search and candidate evaluation.
